rounds.text: Gretex Corporate Services Ltd is riding an unstoppable structural wave, backed by a Financial Services sector tailwind scoring an impressive +0.83 [E72]. The underlying earnings engine is formidable, having delivered a stellar 78% compounded profit growth over five years [E17] alongside a robust 34% sales growth over three years [E15]. Balance sheet integrity is spotless as the company is almost debt free [E54], having aggressively slashed borrowings down to just Rs 2 Cr in March 2026 [E34] while achieving a pristine 1.00x cash conversion with profits fully backed by cash [E29]. This fundamental strength is actively recognized by smart money, evidenced by positive institutional money flow [E39], foreign institutional ownership scaling up to 1.99% [E37], and a maximum relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 [E46]. Market participants are validating this exceptional momentum by keeping the stock sitting proudly at 100% of its 52-week range [E5], supported by a healthy Sharpe ratio of 1.26 [E49] and a strong technical posture where the 50-day moving average sits above the 200-day [E45]. Conceded: [E1] and [E40].
